basic_info.description: Year-End Promotional Pricing, HOA & Closing Cost contributions available for a limited time. Residence 326 is a generously sized, move-in ready two-bed, two-and-a-half-bath residence. Kitchen appointments include Arclinea Italian cabinetry & Miele appliances, Dornbracht faucets and wine fridge. The home offers white oak flooring, and ceiling heights from 9' to 10'5''. Thoughtfully designed primary bathrooms with spa-styled Carrara marble and a freestanding soaking tub, additional powder room, recessed lighting with dimmers, full size vented washer/dryer. Floor-to-ceiling windows frame breathtaking views of the spectacular Eastern span of the Bay Bridge, Port of Oakland, and an abundance of greenery create a picturesque and unobstructed landscape.
